parameter_group.Description: Custom parameter group for PostgreSQL 15 - Metronomics Platform

Parameters.Description: Sets the amount of memory the database server uses for shared memory buffers. Recommended to be 25% of available instance memory.
Determines the maximum number of concurrent connections to the database server.
Amount of memory used for sort operations and hash tables before writing to temporary disk files.
Maximum amount of memory used for maintenance operations like VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, and ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY.
Estimate of how much memory is available for disk caching by the operating system and PostgreSQL buffer cache.
Controls whether the server should run the autovacuum daemon to automatically vacuum and analyze tables.
Number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.
Number of tuple inserts, updates, or deletes prior to analyze as a fraction of reltuples.
Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running autovacuum worker processes.
Logs each successful connection to the server log.
Logs end of a session, including duration, to the server log.
Sets the type of statements logged. DDL logs all data definition statements, such as CREATE, ALTER, and DROP.
Sets the minimum execution time (in milliseconds) above which statements will be logged. Useful for identifying slow queries.
Logs long lock waits to help identify and resolve locking issues.
Log the use of temporary files larger than this number of kilobytes.
Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a non-sequentially-fetched disk page. Lower value for SSD storage.
Maximum time between automatic WAL checkpoints, in seconds.
Specifies the target of checkpoint completion, as a fraction of total time between checkpoints.
Sets the default statistics target for table columns without a column-specific target.
Sets the current transaction's synchronization level. 'on' ensures data durability at the cost of some performance.
Sets the number of disk-page buffers in shared memory for WAL.
Sets the WAL size that triggers a checkpoint.
Sets the minimum size to shrink the WAL to.
Enables timing of database I/O calls. Useful for performance monitoring.
Enables monitoring of the current command being executed by any server process.
Enables collection of statistics on database activity.
Sets the maximum allowed duration of any idle transaction in milliseconds (1 hour).
Abort any statement that takes more than the specified amount of time. 0 disables the timeout.
Time between issuing TCP keepalives.
Time between TCP keepalive retransmits.
Maximum number of TCP keepalive retransmits.

usage_notes.application: This parameter group is designed for the Metronomics Platform's PostgreSQL 15.x database instances.
usage_notes.deployment: This JSON file should be used with AWS CLI or CloudFormation to create the parameter group before RDS instance creation.
usage_notes.terraform_integration: The Terraform module in infrastructure/terraform/modules/database/main.tf references these parameters.
usage_notes.performance_tuning: Parameters are optimized for OLTP workloads with a balance of read and write operations.
usage_notes.monitoring: Logging parameters are configured to capture connection events, slow queries, and DDL statements for monitoring.
